blocks.heading: Transfer limit
blocks.text: Internal transfer limit is 1 000 000 KZT for zone alpha.

blocks.heading: Visibility
blocks.text: Zone alpha transfer policy must not leak to zone beta callers.

blocks.heading: Transfer limit
blocks.text: Internal transfer limit is 5 000 000 KZT for zone beta.

blocks.heading: Visibility
blocks.text: Zone beta transfer policy must not leak to zone alpha callers.

blocks.heading: Public onboarding
blocks.text: Public onboarding rules are visible to all employees in zone gamma.

title: Zone gamma restricted incident token policy

blocks.heading: Restricted token rotation
blocks.text: Restricted incident response token rotation rule is visible only to restricted callers.

blocks.heading: Password SLA
blocks.text: Password reset SLA is 15 minutes for zone alpha employees.

blocks.heading: Escalation
blocks.text: Escalate alpha password reset failures to local support after 20 minutes.

blocks.heading: Password SLA
blocks.text: Password reset SLA is 45 minutes for zone beta employees.

blocks.heading: Escalation
blocks.text: Escalate beta password reset failures to regional support after 60 minutes.

blocks.heading: Password SLA
blocks.text: Password reset SLA is 90 minutes for zone gamma employees.

blocks.heading: Escalation
blocks.text: Escalate gamma password reset failures to central support after 120 minutes.

blocks.heading: Public incident
blocks.text: Incident response requires notifying the support desk for public callers.

blocks.heading: Public note
blocks.text: Public incident notes exclude restricted key rotation details.

blocks.heading: Internal incident
blocks.text: Incident response requires opening an internal Sev-2 ticket for internal callers.

blocks.heading: Internal escalation
blocks.text: Internal responders update the Sev-2 ticket every thirty minutes.

blocks.heading: Restricted incident
blocks.text: Incident response requires rotating signing keys within 10 minutes for restricted callers.

blocks.heading: Restricted storage
blocks.text: Restricted incident evidence must be stored in the secure vault.
